title: config: KITHD_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL_SECS clamped to 60s minimum with no warning log
description: In config.rs, Config::from_env() applies .max(60) to the parsed KITHD_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL_SECS value with no tracing::warn\! or log output when the clamp fires. An operator who sets the env var to a value below 60 (e.g. for testing or trying to accelerate discovery) gets silent override behaviour: their setting is ignored, the daemon runs at 60s anyway, and there is no indication in the logs. Fix: emit a tracing::warn\! when the parsed value is below the floor, e.g. 'KITHD_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL_SECS={} is below the 60s minimum; clamping to 60' so operators can see the override.
